items.question: What is Astro Starter?
items.answer: Astro Starter is a reusable frontend system for building landing pages and small websites faster with Astro, SCSS, design tokens and ready-made widgets.

items.question: Do I need to recreate design tokens for every project?
items.answer: No. Keep token names stable and change their values to match the brand of each project.

items.question: Can I build custom sections?
items.answer: Yes. Use the ready widgets for common cases or compose custom sections manually from layout, UI and media primitives.

items.question: Is ContactForm backend-ready?
items.answer: Yes. It can post to an Astro API route and use console delivery during development. Email delivery can be added later through a provider.
